name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
steps: Stand tall and place one heel forward with toes up.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.

name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
steps: Extend one arm with palm up.
Gently pull the fingers back with the opposite hand.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
steps: Stand tall and grasp your ankle behind you.
Bring knees together and gently pull heel toward glute.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
steps: Bring one arm across your chest.
Use the opposite hand to pull gently toward you.

name: Cat–Cow Flow
steps: Inhale, drop belly and lift chest (Cow).
Exhale, round spine and tuck chin (Cat).
